body:
> While i agree the surrogate char is awkward API design, I'm not sure what problem the PR solves. Could you elaborate on that? Does forcing string operations create any complexities, inefficiencies or bug proneness over passing it explicitly?

My main motivation is to align the API with the language server protocol to make the mapping more seamless. If we expose `EditorLanguage` most implementations will end up calling to premade language servers, so reducing the friction in mapping between them before exposing this seems desirable to me.

At least on the GDScript side it also simplifies code since the flow was `editor inserts char -> gdscripts searches and strips it` (although the way I ended up passing the position to the parser is horrible in hindsight. I'll simplify that I guess.)
